title: Refactor Authentication Module
goal: Refactor the legacy authentication module to use modern patterns, improve testability, and add proper error handling.
constraints: Existing tests must pass. No behavior changes. Keep the public API compatible. All changes must be backward compatible.

features.title: Analyze current auth module
features.description: Read and understand the current authentication module. Document the public API, dependencies, and pain points.

features.title: Create refactoring plan
features.description: Based on the analysis, create a step-by-step plan for refactoring the auth module.

acceptance.description: Plan includes all identified pain points

features.title: Extract token validation
features.description: Extract token validation logic into a separate, testable module.

acceptance.description: Token validation extracted to separate file
Unit tests pass for new module

features.title: Add proper error handling
features.description: Replace generic errors with specific error types and proper error messages.

acceptance.description: All error paths have specific messages

features.title: Run full test suite
features.description: Run the complete test suite and verify all tests pass. Fix any regressions.
